doc.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Are his lyrics funny?
summary: He says his lyrics are sometimes funny but mostly meant to amuse.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I don’t know how to ask this question, but do you — I’ll just ask it — do you think your lyrics are funny?
I mean sometimes it’s hard to be objective about your own work.

Well I mean for them to be. I mean for them to be but I mean a lot of times they’re not jokes, and I don’t know if they’re meant to draw laughs, but they’re certainly meant to amuse the listener, yeah, right.
